insights.one_liner: Justdiggit is an Amsterdam nonprofit regreening degraded land in Africa, offering marketing and communications internships.

culture.text: A nonprofit of about 94 people, founded in 2010, based in Amsterdam.
Staff often studied international studies, communication or development economics, at UvA, University of Nairobi, Wageningen and VU.
It mixes nature-based methods with data, communications and mobile technology, working with farmers and local partners in Africa.
Its 2 open jobs here are both marketing and communications internships in Amsterdam.

open.text: Justdiggit is not an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings are open to people who don't speak Dutch.

growth.text: It says it has dug 800,730 water bunds, recovered over 32.3 million trees and restored almost 525,000 hectares.
